status: Repaired Corrupted Axion destination collapse at platform edges. Native reference/current execution, canonical Release inspection and startup pass. Client visual/soak verification remains pending.
root_cause: The production breath used WorldObject::GetNearPosition -> MovePosition. That walking helper rejects height differences above six yards, retreats in ten steps and can return the original caster position if no candidate is accepted. It can also shorten an otherwise valid projectile's horizontal range.

The exploratory eastward observation was not proof of absent extracted terrain. Native terrain/VMap queries find lower ground at the far points, as well as elevated surfaces in other directions. The old MAX_HEIGHT query with the default250-yard search also misses overhead VMap surfaces; a full vertical search includes them.

Pinned3f88a859 native execution reproduces eastward collapse: Heroic2/3 missiles and Mythic4/5 missiles target Helya's XY. The baseline uses its actual archived final-link libraries and current World data; it also retains the old orb/cleanup/control bugs asserted by the existing baseline suite.
repair: Keep the authored forward XY distances43/56/69/82/95 and difficulty counts0/0/3/5. Use GetNearPoint2D with the actual absolute facing and no creature-size offset, then query the native phase-aware terrain/VMap surface from MAX_HEIGHT with MAX_FALL_DISTANCE. Do not use walking slope or backward-step rules for missile destinations.

Land on the real uppermost supporting surface at each requested XY, including elevated and lower surfaces. If no native surface exists, omit that destination instead of substituting Helya's position or an invented height. All fixture destinations have actual native support and retain their expected difficulty count.

No shared movement/collision function, map extraction, SQL, damage, duration, missile count, range pattern, timers or phase gates changed. Off-platform aiming is not clamped into the arena or made safely soakable by moving the bolts back to the raid.

limits: No authenticated7.3.5 client was driven. Actual flight/telegraph appearance, collision presentation, upper-platform accessibility, edge soaks, damage/healing in a real raid and full encounter/quest completion remain client checks.

Eight native facing inputs are sampled, not every possible angle. All recorded points have valid support; the missing-surface skip is a defensive policy and not a tested missing/corrupt-extraction recovery claim. The test does not prove original retail placement from a replay or packet capture.

The phase-one Bilewater Breath uses a different first-collision helper and was not repaired by this scoped phase-three change. Exact original role selection and unrelated encounter behavior remain outside this fix.
